ارتكبن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَكَبْنَ (irtakabna) /ir.ta.kab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# اُرْتُكِبْنَ (urtukibna) /ur.tu.kib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
# اِرْتَكِبْنَ (irtakibna) /ir.ta.kib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِرْتَكَبَ (irtakaba)
